name: Football Temptations
source:
You play as James, a young American football player with sky-high potential. This spring, his dream began to take shape: drafted by the Philadelphia Sharkhawks and signed to a rookie contract. Against the odds, he earned a spot on the final roster.

[From [url=https://strategicdesiregames.itch.io/football-temptations]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你扮演詹姆斯，一位具有极高潜力的年轻美国橄榄球运动员。今年春天，他的梦想开始成形：被费城鲨鱼鹰队选中并签订了新秀合同。尽管困难重重，他还是在最终名单中获得了一席之地。

[来自[url=https://strategicdesiregames.itch.io/football-temptations]itch.io[/url]]
